activity_summary: With the book already shut, you said how the year's work is divided, and that you know which is which. You named twenty pounds not to be spent, and then you refused the leaf and refused the reason. You ended on counted, tired, not done, good.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the sum, refused the page, and stopped.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Twenty pound of it, not to be spent.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: No. Not on the leaf. Not the reason.
